verdict_reason: The new role tests cover REQ-INS-ADDR-037 well (order, repeats, missing, empty, unknown, mixed-group, receiving outside UK, branch abroad), and the removed round trip is still covered in AddressDeleteIT and AddressUpdateIT; one test title narrates history and its assertion is repeated in another test.

todos.issue: Test title post_shouldIgnoreAnAddressTypeTheBodyStillSends (line 96) narrates history: 'still sends' implies callers used to send addressType. The house rules ban before/after narration in test titles. The spec scenario it witnesses (SCN-INS-ADDR-037-J) says it without history: 'An address type a request carries is not recorded'. Line 79 in post_shouldStoreAndReadBackTheRolesInOrderWithRepeatsCollapsed also asserts $.addressType doesNotExist. The title of that test does not claim it, and line 96's test already owns it.
todos.fix: Must: the title states the current behaviour with no history word, and the addressType absence is asserted only in the test whose title claims it. One way: rename to post_shouldNotRecordAnAddressTypeTheBodyCarries and delete the addressType assertion at line 79.
